method.cases: 1,000 views at normal and 4x CPU, and 100 views at 4x CPU
method.actions: Type chat 99, delete seven characters, navigate down twenty results. Type and delete editor in Settings. Extra untimed navigation smoke jumps from the first result to the final Settings action and runs it with Enter.
method.twoFrameTiming: Trusted keydown timestamp through two requestAnimationFrame callbacks; has a frame pacing floor, not physical display FPS or page INP.
method.eventTiming: Only entries at or above the browser observer threshold are reported; event records do not form a complete latency distribution.
method.cpuRate: Chromium Emulation CPU throttling; not an older physical device
method.isolation: Sequential timing jobs without test/build jobs; temporary project, daemon and fresh browser profile for each sample
method.stageCaveat: Final probes add query and visible-selection audits. Final old/current use identical probes; stage CPU totals should only be compared within their own trial cohort.
